title: Butterfly in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <ellipse cx='32' cy='38' rx='19' ry='16' fill='#ff8a3d' transform='rotate(-18 32 38)'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='38' rx='19' ry='16' fill='#ff8a3d' transform='rotate(18 68 38)'/>

  <circle cx='30' cy='35' r='5' fill='#ffd23f'/>

  <circle cx='24' cy='43' r='3' fill='#ff5ea8'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='43' r='3' fill='#ff5ea8'/>

  <ellipse cx='38' cy='58' rx='13' ry='12' fill='#ff6fa8' transform='rotate(-10 38 58)'/>

  <circle cx='39' cy='15' r='2' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='15' r='2' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <!-- scarf -->
  <path d='M40 40 Q50 47 60 40 Q60 45 50 51 Q40 45 40 40 Z' fill='#33d6c0'/>
  <path d='M44 46 Q40 58 36 64 Q41 63 44 55 Q46 50 46 47 Z' fill='#28b3a0'/>
